skills.name: adversarial-verification
skills.description: Assigns independent agents to attack a claim and its evidence and returns a verdict with the surviving claim, when the user or a calling procedure asks for adversarial review or fact-checking of a numeric, legal, novelty or prior-art claim.

skills.name: agent-security-scan
skills.description: Scans settings, hooks, skills, Model Context Protocol config and credential files for exposure, remote-fetch and shell side-effect risks after any of them or governance logic changes, or when the user asks to inspect suspicious commands.

skills.name: boundary-contract
skills.description: Declares the objective, allowed and prohibited surfaces, criteria, phase and stop conditions of work for which task-router requires a boundary contract.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Resolves open design decisions, including expected behavior, before implementation.

skills.name: compact-handoff
skills.description: Records the objective, boundary, evidence and next action in a handoff when long context, a task transfer to another session or agent, or compaction could lose them, before that transfer or compaction, and resumes work from the handoff.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Delegates independent tasks to parallel agents, one self-contained assignment each, then reviews and integrates their results, when two or more tasks share no edited file, exclusive resource or mutable state and none waits on another task's result.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Executes an accepted plan inline in the authorized checkout when inline execution is chosen.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Runs applicable CI checks locally before a push or merge and executes the user's chosen path (local merge, pull request, keep or discard), when work is ready to integrate or the user asks to push, merge, open a pull request or discard a branch.

skills.name: merge-companion
skills.description: Reviews the user changes that a skill installer backed up, before the selected work modifies, replaces or installs an installed skill and when the user asks for that review. Not for a read-only lookup unrelated to those changes.

skills.name: necessity-gate
skills.description: Approves, modifies or rejects proposed new work (a task, skill, file, tool, audit or verification cycle, follow-up or production skill edit) when the current-session assistant defines it, not substeps or checks inside already approved work.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Judges each code review finding against the user's requirements, the current code and tests, then fixes it if valid and authorized, rejects it with evidence or reports it unresolved, when review feedback arrives and before any code is changed.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Dispatches a code-reviewer subagent to review a commit range and confirms a pull request's reviews and CI cover its current head, after a major feature is built, before merging, or when a pull request has new commits, findings or unresolved threads.

skills.name: session-intent-analyzer
skills.description: Writes a new or changed interpreted-as record before the first tool call of work, and reads stored intent when it can affect the objective, constraints, authorized continuation or work selection.

skills.name: skill-evolution
skills.description: Recommends skill changes from repeated tool/workflow patterns and supported conduct corrections when the user asks about skill upgrades, update recommendations or an evolution backlog, or authorizes an analysis of those patterns.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Executes an accepted plan in the current session, one task at a time through a fresh implementer, when subagent execution is chosen and each task can be assigned independently.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Before a fix is proposed for a failure whose cause and sufficient correction depth need investigation, tests causal hypotheses and corrects the supported cause; also counts failed repair rounds against the repair limit.

skills.name: task-router
skills.description: Selects the work, skills, criteria and boundary for a request that needs or may need a tool, other than a light-path lookup. Not for a direct answer or a confirmation question.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Writes a failing test first for a feature or bug fix whose expected behavior is known and automatically testable. Not for configuration, generated-output or instruction changes without a meaningful behavioral test.

skills.name: using-coding-convention
skills.description: Selects the coding-convention family skill before development work's first file read, command, edit, plan or review. Not for a direct answer or a confirmation question.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Selects or creates an isolated checkout, only when the authorized development task requires isolation.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Checks each new completion, fix, success, verified-status or material recommendation claim against its criterion and evidence before the claim is made, and decides whether an artifact must be reread to support a claim.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Writes an implementation plan that breaks accepted requirements into tasks an implementer without project context can execute, when a multi-step task's requirements are settled and before implementation, not while design decisions remain open.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Writes a new skill or changes or tests an existing one, in its SKILL.md, references and scripts. Not for documents outside a skill package.
